messages:
liam (docs): Quick bug: docs for /v1/create-item mark `metadata` as nullable but all examples show `{}`. A user opened an issue because sending `null` 400s in Python example.

alex (sdk): Which example? I maintain the Python helper.

liam (docs): docs/reference/items.md, curl and python snippets. Python example does `metadata={}` and the text says 'nullable', but the server rejects `null` when sent in JSON body from python-requests because of validation.

nora (api): Runtime note: validator treats missing field and empty object as valid, but explicit `null` is rejected for that endpoint due to older schema with `object` type (no explicit nullable:true). We intended to accept null; current schema drifted.

sam (pm): So docs claim nullable but runtime disagrees. Breaking for users who expect to pass null to clear metadata. What's the plan?

liam (docs): Two options: 1) fix runtime schema to accept null OR 2) change docs to show canonical usage (omit field or pass `{}`) and add migration note. Prefer runtime fix since API surface says nullable. Need API + infra signoff.

nora (api): I'll own the runtime fix. Quick patch to schema to allow `null` will go through validation and we can roll out in next deploy. But we should also update docs to show both canonical patterns in the meantime and a short migration note.

alex (sdk): I'll update SDK helpers to accept None/null and translate into JSON `null` for requests once runtime patch lands. For backward compatibility, SDK will also support omitting the key or sending `{}`. I'll submit a combined docs+sdk PR so examples stay consistent.

ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1012 by alex (sdk)  runs: lint, examples test.

liam (docs): PR changes: docs/reference/items.md - updated param table to show "nullable: true" and two short examples: omit field, pass `metadata: null`.

nora (api): Runtime PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/456 by nora (api)  includes schema update to accept `null` for metadata, unit test, and validator flag. Rolling to staging.

alex (sdk): SDK PR includes updated examples/python/items_example.py showing `metadata=None`, updated JS snippet, and unit test ensuring client serializes None -> null. Also added a small deprecation helper for callers that previously passed empty string.

ci-bot: docs lint reported one example formatting nit. alex (sdk) pushed fix.

ci-bot: All checks passed for docs PR #1012.

nora (api): Staging deploy looks good, schema change applied, tests green. Will schedule prod deploy in the next maintenance window.

sam (pm): Add a brief release-note entry: "Docs + SDK: clarified nullable `metadata` parameter and SDK now supports None/null. Runtime schema updated to accept null for /v1/create-item." Keep it under Docs clarifications.

alex (sdk): Merged docs PR after CI. SDK PR merged to main with feature flag; will release a patch version.

ci-bot: Runtime PR #456 merged and scheduled for deploy.

liam (docs): Draft release-note blurb: "Docs: clarified nullable `metadata` on /v1/create-item. You can omit the field or pass `null` to clear metadata. SDKs now accept None/null and will serialize accordingly. Runtime schema updated."

sam (pm): LGTM. Thanks for the quick coordination.

liam (docs): Closing thread. If you find other fields documented as nullable, tag me and I'll sweep the reference.
